title: ‘Hundreds’ of Russian missiles and drones hit Ukraine as Poland scrambles jets
summary: At least 10 people were wounded in the overnight strikes on Kyiv and other regions as Poland takes preventive measure to secure airspace Overnight Russian strikes on Ukraine involving “hundreds” of drones and missiles have wounded at least 10 people on Sunday, as Poland scrambled fighter jets to secure its airspace. An air raid alert was in place over the Kyiv region, with the local military administration saying Russia was attacking with drones and missiles. Continue reading...
